title: Accel closes oversubscribed $550M India fund within weeks, 19 months after its last
summary: Accel has closed a new $550 million India fund, less than two years after raising its previous India-focused vehicle, as part of a coordinated $3.5 billion global fundraising effort. The trend is already visible across leading AI companies.
